text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Parliament's legal committee on Sunday approved a proposed law which would allow 18-year-old nationals to vote in public elections. The panel rejected another draft law which would grant servicemen the right to vote.
- Syria's Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam to arrive in Kuwait today (Monday) to deliver message to Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah from Syrian President Hafez al-Assad.
- Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) to put 15 million units of a local mutual fund for public subscription.

- Secretary General of the Arab League Esmat Abdel-Meguid calls for the release of Kuwaiti prisoners detained in Iraq since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis. Kuwait says Iraq still holds about 600 Kuwaitis. Iraq denies.
- Iran's Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati says his country rejects Turkish-Israeli military cooperation.
- Ministry of Public Health places controls on sale and promotion of health food.
- Government to present parliament with a proposed solution to the issue of illegal residents. Kuwait has about 100,000 stateless people whom it describes as illegal residents.
